title: Multi-Scale Control of Large Agent Populations: From Density Dynamics to Individual Actuation
summary: We review a body of recent work by the author and collaborators on controlling the spatial organisation of large agent populations across multiple scales. A central theme is the systematic bridging of microscopic agent-level dynamics and macroscopic density descriptions, enabling control design at the most natural level of abstraction and subsequent translation across scales.
